question: I completed 15-150 (Principles of Functional Programming) but not 15-122. Does my 15-150 credit satisfy the programming prerequisite for 15-251 (Great Ideas in Theoretical Computer Science)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-251's prerequisite accepts either 15-122 at least C OR 15-150 at least C for the programming component. A student who completed 15-150 (with at least C) and also satisfies the math component (21-127, 21-128, or 15-151) is eligible to take 15-251 even without 15-122.
common_mistake: Assuming 15-122 is the only programming prerequisite for 15-251; not recognizing that 15-150 is a valid alternative path to 15-251
needs_verification: Confirm 15-251 prereq text: (15-122 C or 15-150 C) AND (math prereq)
Confirm student has a grade of C or better in 15-150
Confirm student also satisfies the math component of 15-251 (21-127, 21-128, or 15-151)
